title: Sprint 4 — NPM Package Distribution
description: Packages the harness as an NPM module (@gugamistri/harness) so it can be installed into any project via `npx @gugamistri/harness init`. A zero-dependency Node.js CLI copies harness files (skills, personas, rules, docs, specs schema, AGENTS.md) from the package into the target project directory. Supports selective module install, --force overwrite, and --dry-run preview.

acceptanceCriteria.description: package.json exists with name @gugamistri/harness, version 0.6.0, bin.harness pointing to ./bin/cli.js, files array excluding specs/*.json and CHANGELOG.md, engines.node >=18, no runtime dependencies

bin/cli.js is executable, zero external dependencies, implements: init (copy all or --modules subset), update (init --force), list (show available modules), help. Handles --force and --dry-run flags. Skips existing files by default with warning.
`node bin/cli.js init --dry-run` runs without error and prints what would be installed
`node bin/cli.js init` in a temp directory creates skills/, personas/, rules/, docs/, specs/README.md, AGENTS.md

publishInstructions.update: bump version in package.json, git tag vX.Y.Z, npm publish --access public

notes: The repo remains usable as a direct clone/fork — package.json and bin/ are additive. specs/*.json (project-specific tracking files) are excluded from the npm bundle via the files array. Users who install via npx get only the harness skeleton; they create their own specs/ entries for their projects.
